Ravi K: Quick live thread for follow-ups from today’s all-hands re: sales pipeline & partner updates. Drop clarifying Qs and owners will reply.
Marta T: For the enterprise SKU, will it be available to self-serve signups or only via sales? We need clarity for the pricing page.
Omar J: Initial plan: enterprise must go through sales (contract + onboarding). Docs team will add a banner to pricing page with a contact form.
Priya V: How will existing customers be migrated to the enterprise SKU if they want reserved capacity? Any credits or discounts?
Omar J: We propose migration credits (one-time) based on remaining committed spend. Pricing to finalize the credit formula next week.
Marta T: Partner question: will we require partners to be on a Dedicated or Private plan to qualify for co-sell? That affects partner targeting.
Priya V: Pilot allows partners with customers on Hosted or Dedicated. Private deployments require attestations but are acceptable. We'll document eligibility.
Ravi K: Action items: Pricing to confirm migration credits; Docs to update pricing page with CTAs; Partnerships to publish eligibility. I'll post a one-page summary tomorrow.
ops-bot: Reminder: Fill the all-hands feedback form if you haven't yet.
Marta T: Thanks all 44d
